'''Eadyth''' (pronounced: ee-DITH) is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Blue Ajah]]. 

==Appearance==

She has long white hair to her waist. {{Ref/book|0|12}}

==History==
Her long white hair suggests she is very old for an Aes Sedai, likely well over 200 years old.

Eadyth was the [[First Selector]] of the Blue Ajah, as well as a [[Sitter]] in the Hall. 
She was considered one of the most capable Blue in the last one hundred years and was [[First Selector]] during this time. {{Ref/book|0|12}}

==Activities==
She is one of the Blue Ajah Sitters who present the shawl to [[Moiraine Damodred]] and [[Siuan Sanche]] when they first become Aes Sedai. {{Ref/book|0|11}}

She is the one who has to explain, reluctantly, about how an Aes Sedai must always defer to someone who is stronger than her in the [[One Power|Power]]. {{Ref/book|0|12}} Eadyth also gives Moiraine and Siuan letters-of-rights for their annual stipends of a thousand gold crowns.

Some time later Eadyth, [[Kairen Stang|Kairen]] and [[Sheriam Bayanar|Sheriam]] take note of Moiraine going out of the [[White Tower|Tower]] on horse; Moiraine explains she is going out for a "ride" but secretly she leaves to find the [[Dragon Reborn]]{{Ref/book|0|14}}. 

==Speculation==
It can be rather safely assumed that Eadyth has died since the [[Aiel War]], as she is not mentioned in the main series, and such a prominent Blue would surely have been on, for instance, the [[Salidar Six]], had she for some reason stepped down from her position. Furthermore, [[Lelaine Akashi]] is now the First Selector, and various evidence suggests [[Anaiya Carel]] was so before her. Being a Sitter means that she was also a senior sister. She may have died of old age; she may have gone into retirement; she may have been one of the sisters killed during "[[The Vileness]]". She may also have been the Blue Sitter who was killed during the [[White Tower Schism|White Tower schism]].
